programs.name: Flex 1-Step
programs.drawdown_type: static (12% below initial balance, includes floating P&L)
programs.consistency_rule: No consistency rule. Concentration check at the end of the evaluation: if one trade idea made more than 60% of the profit target, the funded account needs 4 trading days (each closing up at least 0.5%) before a payout can be requested
programs.profit_split: 85%; drops to 60% after a second news-trading strike
programs.payout_frequency: every 14 days; first reward 14 days after the first trade on the funded (earnings) account
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum payout is 1% of initial balance ($500 on 50K). Risk per trade idea must stay under 1% of initial balance (first breach: positions closed; second breach: account closed). No high-impact news trades within 5 minutes of the event (strike 1: profit deducted; strike 2: profit deducted and split cut to 60%; strike 3: account closed). Fee refund not stated.
programs.notes: Launched 17 Aug 2026. Sizes $5K-$100K (the store also lists a $200K variant at $1,600). Daily loss is 3% from the higher of opening balance or equity. No minimum trading days to pass, no time limit. Weekend holding NOT allowed (positions may be closed). Leverage 1:30 FX, 1:10 metals/indices/commodities, 1:2 crypto. 30-day inactivity breach. Reset of 50K Phase 1 is $343 (30% off), funded reset $980; reset must be bought within 7 days of the breach, once per account.

programs.name: Prime 2-Step
programs.payout_rules_note: Each 14-day reward cycle needs 3 active trading days (accounts bought from 17 Aug 2026; 5 for earlier accounts); an active day needs closed trades of at least 0.5% profit. No lot size restriction and no risk-per-trade limit on Prime. Minimum payout and fee refund not stated.
programs.notes: Phase 1 target 8% ($4,000), Phase 2 6% ($3,000). Daily drawdown 4% of initial balance measured from the higher of balance or equity at day start. Sizes $2.5K-$200K. Leverage 1:30. News: no new positions within 2 minutes before/after scheduled high-impact news; managing or closing existing trades is allowed. The 3-day minimum applies per phase per the Oct 2026 Outline & Fees PDF ('3 or 5'). Store lists DXtrade at a lower $325, but DXtrade accounts were migrated to MT5 in April 2026; MT5/TradeLocker price is $406. Phase 1 reset $285, Phase 2 reset $406, funded reset $812.

programs.name: 1-Step
programs.payout_frequency: every 14 days; 7-day and on-demand reward add-ons available
programs.payout_rules_note: Reward needs at least $100 realized profit and 3 active trading days in the cycle. Funded accounts have a 1.5% risk-per-trade-idea hard limit ($750 on 50K). The 7-day reward add-on costs 20% on top of the challenge price.
programs.notes: Sizes $5K-$200K. Daily loss 4% of starting balance from the higher of balance or equity, resets 5:00 PM EST. No high-impact news trading. Weekend holding allowed. Leverage 1:30. The Outline & Fees PDF says the 1-Step closed to new sales on 17 Aug 2026, but a 24 Aug 2026 correction in the help center says it remains available, and it is still sold on the homepage. Homepage and help center show $302.50; the store API shows $302.00.

news_trading: Restricted: general rule (all evaluation and funded accounts) bans opening or closing trades from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after high-impact (red folder) news; stop-loss hits are allowed if the position was opened 6+ hours before. Prime: no new positions within 2 minutes of scheduled high-impact news; closing allowed. Flex 1-Step: 5-minute window with a strike system (profit deduction, split cut to 60%, then closure)
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: only proprietary EAs that encode your own strategy and are disclosed to and approved by the firm before use; commercial/third-party EAs not allowed. Synthetic plans bought from 8 Oct 2026 allow EAs under the same conditions; older synthetic accounts do not
copy_trading: Restricted: only between your own Blueberry Funded accounts; copy trading with third parties or third-party account management is prohibited (immediate termination)
overnight_weekend_holding: Overnight holding allowed on all account types. Weekend holding allowed on all account types except Flex 1-Step (positions may be closed automatically before the weekend)
restricted_countries_note: Restricted: Afghanistan, American Samoa, Australia, Belarus, Cuba, Guam, Iran, Iraq, Myanmar, North Korea, Russia, Somalia, Syria, United States, US Minor Outlying Islands, Yemen.
payout_methods: Broker Rewards: transfer approved rewards to a personal Blueberry Markets account

current_public_promo.discount: 30% off the Prime challenge (FLEX30 gives 30% off Flex 1-Step)
current_public_promo.applies_to: Prime and Flex 1-Step challenges, per Blueberry's homepage (no discount shown on the 1-Step)

affiliate_program.commission: First purchase: 12.5% (0-25 lifetime referrals), 15% (26-75), 17.5% (76-150), 20% (151-225 and 226+); 10% lifetime commission on repeat purchases by referred clients
affiliate_program.notes: Higher tiers add challenge/giveaway accounts and personal discount codes. Withdrawals can be requested any time and are paid in weekly batches (usually Thursdays; 12:00 PM EST cutoff) via RiseWorks or crypto; no minimum stated. Serbia: the help center articles do not mention country eligibility for affiliates, and the affiliate page (blueberryfunded.com/affiliate/) was behind a bot-protection screen and could not be read, so Serbian eligibility could not be confirmed.
